title: 'La Gran Caravana Queretana' to depart Laredo Dec. 16, crossing into Nuevo Laredo at dawn
excerpt: Paisanos heading home to Mexico for Christmas will gather at the Sames Auto Arena in Laredo for the annual caravan into Nuevo Laredo, departing at 4 a.m. on Tuesday, Dec. 16, with the border crossing expected to wrap up by about 7 a.m.
content:
Paisanos heading home to Mexico for the Christmas season will gather at the Sames Auto Arena in Laredo for the annual caravan into Nuevo Laredo, departing at 4 a.m. on Tuesday, Dec. 16, with the border crossing expected to conclude by about 7 a.m., according to Posta Tamaulipas.

Registration for motorists interested in joining the caravan is Monday, Dec. 15. The caravan, identified in a photo caption as "La Gran Caravana Queretana," departs from Laredo, enters Mexico through Nuevo Laredo and continues on to different states across the country, the report said. No specific destination states or highway were named.

About 6,000 vehicles were counted in the previous edition of the caravan, and significant participation is expected again this year, though no forecast number for this edition was given, according to the report.

Preparations are underway, Juan Carlos Mendoza Sánchez, Consul of Mexico in Laredo, said, according to the report. Personnel from the Mexican Consulate, customs and immigration authorities, and police and security agencies on both sides of the border, along with support organizations, are coordinating to facilitate the international crossing, speed up border procedures, accompany the paisanos and provide protection for Mexicans returning home for the holidays.

The Sames Auto Arena serves as the reception and organization point for this year's caravan, replacing the gathering places used in the first editions and allowing more orderly preparation before the move into Mexican territory, the report said. Motorists are advised to follow the organizers' instructions and complete the registration procedures. The Consulate will also offer guidance to people planning to return to Mexico definitively and needing to move their belongings from the United States.

Source: Posta Tamaulipas, November 10, 2026.
